hypothesis: Replacing only the middle-scale independent token FFN with fixed geometric directional convolution can exchange spatial context among 64 middle tokens before original HCG readback, improving referential localization. Efficacy unknown until native training.
mechanism: Six nearest directional donors plus self; dominant absolute xyz delta axis/sign, tie axis xyz and donor token ID; no self, duplicate center or padding; missing direction zero. Depthwise 7xC kernel+bias then CxC pointwise/GELU, without new residual. Fine/coarse FFNs and CSORT/raw hierarchy remain unchanged.
matched_control: Unmodified M95 same data/seed1999/50epochs/maxiters70. Resource matched native sample bs1 warmup20 repeat100 unchanged fvcore. Two actual native TRAIN loss/backward/optimizer steps precede queue.
known_risks: Middle graph can connect different coarse parents.
Two native steps establish execution only; no efficacy claim.
historical_comparison: M116-CGA used feature-cosine top8 graph, Q/K/V/O and two GATs per scale, unlike fixed geometric middle-only depthwise convolution. Historical negative evidence retained; no held candidate reopened.
